rule: A parked design is not run by the scheduled lab. Its design file, registration, ledger rows and last evidence card stay exactly as recorded; nothing is retired, deleted or re-versioned, and a parked design reaches no checkpoint while parked. Parking and unparking are operator decisions made by pull request. Not established: how a design's hourly control selection treats the parked interval if it is later unparked - check that before unparking.
